sources.entry: MiroTalk SFU - Simple, secure, scalable real-time video conferences up to 4k, compatible with all browsers and platforms. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: MiroTalk SFU is a self-hosted, open-source WebRTC video conferencing platform built on the mediasoup SFU architecture.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a self-hosted video conferencing server that runs on Node.js or Docker, using mediasoup as its selective forwarding unit. Its features include video calls with screen sharing, recording, picture-in-picture, and a chat with Markdown, emoji, and optional GIF search. It also offers a collaborative whiteboard, rich text editor, file sharing, and OIDC authentication with room passwords and host protection. Other listed items are a REST API, RTMP streaming with WHIP ingest, Slack/Discord/Mattermost integrations, an embeddable iframe widget, and 133 interface languages. The README also mentions optional ChatGPT and DeepSeek integrations and VideoAI avatars. Setup is a git clone, copying config templates, npm install, and npm start, or a Docker Compose setup.
use_cases: team video calls with data kept on own server
webinars and live streaming via RTMP
embedding video rooms in a website
notable: Built on the mediasoup SFU architecture for scalable multi-party calls
Built-in RTMP streaming and WHIP ingest for OBS-style broadcasts
Full REST API and embeddable iframe/widget
Optional OIDC authentication, JWT credentials, and room passwords
caveats: The README says the project was tested with Node.js 24.X, and its Ubuntu setup example requires FFmpeg and Python packages
A separate paid license under terms other than AGPLv3 is offered through CodeCanyon
Modifications distributed under AGPLv3 must also be made available publicly
